name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A small native well that fills with ink when checked.
use: A yes or no that is submitted with a form, alone or in a group where any number can be checked. Wrap it with its text in a check label so the whole row is the target.

instead.when: Only one of the options can be chosen
The setting takes effect at once, without a save button
Each option needs a title and a description

keyboard.action: Toggles the checkbox, as the native input does

classes.name: check
classes.description: A label row around a checkbox, a radio or a switch and its text; it takes disabled ink while its control is disabled

classes.name: checkbox
classes.description: A native type="checkbox" input: a square well with a chip's corner

states.name: checked
states.description: The well fills with ink and shows a check

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: The well fills with ink and shows a dash. Set the indeterminate property from script; HTML has no attribute for it

example: <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox" checked> Email me about releases</label>
